_note: Shared frame for the night build. Floor metres (dog, tap3 on the venue floor) are projected onto the map at floor_anchor for the demo; this is a display choice, not a survey.

floor_anchor._doc: floor (0,0) = marker M1; +x east, +y south (image down); rotation clockwise. DEMO SCALING: 1 dog floor cell (0.5 m) = 1 map cell (50 m), i.e. scale = 50 / 0.5 = 100, so the 6 x 4 m venue floor stands in for a 600 x 400 m search sector. Shown on the replay page and on the map.

modality_weight._dog_bark_doc: zoom Nov 8: lowered 0.5 -> 0.3 (low weight): zero-shot PANNs bark detector, P 0.61 / R 0.75 at 0.5 on expert labels (zoom/land/RESULTS.md)

cot._doc: Unconfirmed contact = a-u-G (unknown ground). After a human confirms, the same uid is re-emitted as a-f-G (friendly ground), so ATAK updates the pin in place. a-h-* (hostile) is refused by fuse.py: a survivor is not hostile.

fields._doc: Probability fields added to the COP by sensor events. mass = modality_weight[kind] x confidence (skyfix: skyfix_weight). Sigmas in map metres; ILLUSTRATIVE, hand-set.
fields._cap_doc: Each source's summed field is scaled down so its mass on the grid is at most source_cap_frac x the prior's mass (prior normalised to 1). Stops one chatty sensor (e.g. many dog alerts) from dominating the COP.
fields._zoom_doc: Zoom build (Nov 8): aerial_person = AerialPerson-YOLO26 box georeferenced via ODM poses (sigma from the event, default 25 m); sonar_human_body = UATD detector call-out, Gaussian clipped to water cells; water_prior_mass = uniform mass (x prior) over water cells within water_corridor_m of the boat track. All hand-set.

perch_point._doc: where the perched drone listens (demo); Perch 'send to fusion' emits here

assets._doc: Next Best Action ETAs: straight line, terrain-free. Hints only; nothing is auto-tasked.

coverage._drone_doc: thermal day POD 0.6 from the pass-1 spec table (not field-calibrated)
